panels.description: An amber Legacy Protocol signal pulses through Keel's pump hall, rail gate, Halyard and Oasis while Alex and Ada move along the unmonitored maintenance lane. Keep upper signal path clear.
In an Oasis control room, Mera sees the Legacy Protocol alert on a cold display. Keep upper display clear.
Mera aligns a glass of water with the desk edge, then stops correcting it. Keep upper desk clear.
Alex and Ada emerge from the service route at the perimeter of Site 6, small beneath the mine structures. Keep upper worksite clear.

items.text: LEGACY PROTOCOL DETECTED — SOURCE: KEEL SECTOR.
